events.comment: Fire_Knight_Boss: the Fire Knight fight. The scene links Player_Movement and Combat_Shared before this sheet. A close-range swordsman who chases the player down. He fights with a fixed rotation of attacks per phase (RotP1, RotP2) once he is in range, closes distance with a Dash Strike, and reacts: he guards every GuardEvery-th swing and counters, and backsteps out when crowded. Fire moves fill his Heat. At 100 Heat he Overheats with a blast around him, then vents and takes extra posture damage. Losing his first life starts the Rekindle and phase 2. Frame numbers below are GDevelop frame indexes, starting at 0.
Scene start: set his speed and start his timers. He waits a moment in Intro before fighting.
His state clock: StateT counts the seconds since the current state or step started.
Keep the enemy bars just above his head. His frame is 288x128 with the body in the lower middle, the same as the Leaf Ranger.
Heat glow: the more Heat, the hotter his colour. Venting cools it back down.
The player is gone: stand idle.
Final death: play the death animation and leave the body on its last frame.
Safety net: no lives left, but he is not in his death state, so die now.

Lost a life: the Rekindle. He drops to one knee, sword planted, for RekindleTime seconds. He CAN be hit here, and every hit comes off his phase 2 HP, so an aggressive player starts phase 2 ahead. His posture is held at 0, so it cannot break.
Rekindle: keep posture at 0 while he kneels.
Rekindle: the kneel is over. He rises in a burst of flame. He cannot be hit now.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Rekindle burst: on frame 12 the flames hit both sides of him, to push the player off.
Rekindle over: phase 2. Faster, a faster rotation, a shorter dash cooldown and Heat that fills faster.
Posture broken: cancel everything and kneel. Combat_Shared runs the stun and the deathblow.
Stun over: get up and carry on. A deathblow that took a life is handled by the Rekindle above.
A lunge landed: flinch. His heavy fire moves (Flame Wave, Overheat, the vent and the Rekindle) have super armour and ignore it.
Flinch over: back to Neutral.
Vent: hits on him while he cools down add VentPostureBonus extra posture. This is the reward for surviving the Overheat.
Guard decision: every GuardEvery-th swing near him, while he is standing in Neutral and the guard is off cooldown, he blocks it. No randomness, so it can be learned.
This is the swing he blocks.
The blocked swing never reached him: forget the block, so it does not catch a later hit.
Blocked a swing: raise the sword with a spark and a clash, then counter with a slash.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Guard over: the counter slash comes straight away.
Intro: after a moment, start fighting.
Neutral: face the player.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Overheat: at 100 Heat, the next thing he does in Neutral is blow up. The blast hits both sides of him, so roll away or out of it.
Crowded: count how long the player stays within TooClose.
Crowded for CrowdTime seconds: backstep away if there is room behind him, otherwise answer with the Flame Wave.
Room behind him: roll away from the player, facing the way he rolls.
Cornered: Flame Wave.
Neutral, player far away: Dash Strike to close the gap when it is off cooldown. Each phase has its own cooldown.
Neutral, in range: when the action delay for this phase is over, take the next attack from the rotation.
Phase 1: wait ActionDelayP1, then read the next code from RotP1.
Phase 2: wait ActionDelayP2, then read the next code from RotP2.
Code S: Slash.
Code C: Combo.
Code E: Eruption.
Code F: Flame Wave.
Neutral, out of reach: run toward the player.
Neutral, close enough: stand.
Slash: on frame 4 the blade comes over his head and down in front of him, about 130 px of reach. Melee, so a deflect costs him posture.
Slash finished: back to Neutral.
Combo and Eruption, first hit: the same overhead slash on frame 4.
Combo: he steps in during the spin, frames 9 to 13.
Combo, second hit: the spin on frame 11.
Combo, third hit: the rising cut on frame 14.

Eruption: on frame 22 he raises the sword and Heat rises. On frame 23 the ground in front of him explodes, from 40 to 205 px away. Not melee, so a deflect stops the damage but costs him no posture. Standing right next to him is safe.
Combo or Eruption finished: back to Neutral.
Flame Wave: frames 0 to 11 are the tell, the flame swinging over his head. On frame 12 it slams down in front of him, up to 210 px away. Not melee. Super armour: a lunge does not flinch him.
Flame Wave finished: back to Neutral.
Dash Strike: frames 0 to 2 are the crouch. On frame 3 he lunges at the player and stops DashStop px in front of them. One melee hitbox covers the whole path and the thrust past its end.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Dash Strike: move at DashSpeed until he reaches TargetX.

parameters: clamp(Fire_Knight.X() + Fire_Knight.Variable(Facing) * Fire_Knight.Variable(DashSpeed) * TimeDelta(), Fire_Knight.Variable(ArenaMinX), Fire_Knight.Variable(ArenaMaxX))

events.comment: Dash Strike finished: back to Neutral and start the dash cooldown.
Backstep: roll away at RollSpeed for the length of the roll.

parameters: clamp(Fire_Knight.X() + Fire_Knight.Variable(MoveDir) * Fire_Knight.Variable(RollSpeed) * TimeDelta(), Fire_Knight.Variable(ArenaMinX), Fire_Knight.Variable(ArenaMaxX))

events.comment: Roll over. Phase 1: back to Neutral. Phase 2: dash straight back in, an in-and-out attack.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Overheat blast: on frame 12 the flames hit both sides of him.
Overheat over: vent. He hunches over, frozen on a frame of the hit reaction, for VentTime seconds while his Heat drains.
Vent over: back to Neutral.
Hitboxes: count down each one's Life and remove it when time is up.
Time is up.
Debug, Numpad1: the Slash. Remove before release.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Debug, Numpad2: the Combo. Remove before release.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Debug, Numpad3: the Eruption. Remove before release.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Debug, Numpad4: the Flame Wave. Remove before release.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Debug, Numpad5: the Dash Strike. Remove before release.
Player on his right: face right.
Player on his left: face left.
Debug, Numpad6: the backstep. Remove before release.
Debug, Numpad7: fill his Heat, so he Overheats next. Remove before release.
Debug, Numpad8: put him on 1 HP, so the next hit takes a life. Remove before release.
Debug text: his state, phase, Heat and HP.

parameters: "FK: " + Fire_Knight.VariableString(AIState) + "  Phase " + ToString(Fire_Knight.Variable(Phase)) + "  Heat " + ToString(round(Fire_Knight.Variable(Heat))) + "  HP " + ToString(round(Fire_Knight.Variable(Health))) + "  Lives " + ToString(Fire_Knight.Variable(Lives))
